observations.contract: Exact worker job and payload admission
observations.trace: The Wasm boundary decodes a ticket and exact serialized job; worker generation decodes job and CBOR dependencies, checks a supplied venue recipe program, then generates and CBOR-encodes a typed product. Receive checks the ticket and job owner, decodes a typed product, and admits venue only when job program equals venue.recipe.program, building only when program equals facade.program, and regional city only when document and graphics match. Those checks establish variant and stated identities, not a certificate for every field within a product.
observations.remaining: Trace all supported producers and payload provenance and resolve whether native admission must defensively validate internal geometry and recipe coherence; do not presume an arbitrary or forged payload is supported.

observations.contract: Field-local packed geometry and render consumption
observations.trace: PreparedBatch stores positions, normals, UVs, optional tangents and indices in separately packed arrays. The packed Pod decoder checks each byte length is an integral number of elements and copies into aligned allocation. PreparedBatch::into_mesh inserts these arrays and indices without a local cross-array length, index-range or triangle-multiple check. The normal recipe_mesh producer derives position, normal and UV arrays from the same vertices, copies indices, and generates tangents for selected materials; venue generation compiles the mesh and interior from the recipe.
observations.remaining: This is a bounded source observation linked to historical queue1309–1310, not proof of malformed supported data or a renderer failure. Investigate LodMesh generation invariants, all admission boundaries, cache trust policy and native Bevy mesh semantics independently; distinguish semantic consistency, index safety and resource capacity.

observations.trace: The optional IndexedDB cache keys job text with cache format and executable revision, checks record revision, compressed and decoded size limits, SHA-256 of compressed bytes and exact decompressed size. Corrupt/unavailable cache can fall back to generation. The main coordinator removes cached results only for typed product-decode or product-mismatch errors and otherwise propagates failures. Its SHA-256 is an integrity check over bytes paired with the stored checksum, not an authenticated provenance guarantee.
observations.remaining: No forged or corrupted cache, hash collision, resource exhaustion or native outcome is observed. Resolve the actual trust contract and all cache/worker write and read paths before classifying a product defect.

observations.trace: venue_jobs skips an already resident matching program without checking geometry Option. Installation takes the active venue geometry before prepared::install checks recipe bounds centre and facade openings, then adds compiled levels to Bevy cache. A cached compiled program/detail is reused before taking geometry; clear_scene_entities retains compiled levels while clearing temporary recipes, and clear_demo_scene resets that cache and attempts Wasm residency clearing. The source test starts replacement preparation before taking active geometry and then asserts no replacement venue job; staged products were cloned at begin.
observations.remaining: A failed install after take could leave geometry absent unless another resident clone/cache supplies it, but valid generated same-recipe path already calculates bounds centre and dynamic closure solids during preparation. Supported reachability, partial failure, reset scheduling and subsequent callers remain open; no failure or missing geometry was observed. Source tests are unexecuted.

observations.trace: PreparedStrategicScene::from_products validates primary and promoted placement equality, finds the venue by program, installs interior into a local scene and checks all primary buildings before returning. The caller assigns the completed scene only after that construction succeeds. Wasm maps the typed PreparationError to JavaScript Error.name from its code and a display message at the boundary.
observations.remaining: The successor preparation error owner, all native/browser consumers, semantic error causes, scene data and exact aliases need independent scope. These safeguards do not establish whole-product semantic validity.
